hypothesis: A reference that reserves more body clearance can improve perturbation tolerance without reverting to a pivot controller

geometry.target: 0.9 times achieved continuous clearance of old clearance-first path
geometry.segments: three quintic Bezier segments with zero endpoint curvature
geometry.smooth_objective: 12 max curvature +60 curvature derivative energy +.6 curvature variation +.002 length
geometry.postcheck: continuous footprint at dense path samples must meet target; otherwise held

speed_mode: same_mode retains current per-movement legacy/planned mode; planned applies spatial braking/acceleration to every turn
controller: same corrected teacher gains heading1.3 lateral.08; no boundary guard, to isolate reference/speed change
straight: same original straight reference/controller in both arms; executed and retained
selection: report all movements, all candidates and failures; no automatic replacement
